## Contribution practices

- Write clear commit messages. One logical change per commit.
- Link the issue a pull request closes.
- Squash fixup commits before review.
- Include a screenshot for UI changes.
- Bug reports need reproduction steps and the version.

Read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `docs/testing.md` before starting. The issue tracker
is <https://github.com/quexenbp/Deniz/issues>.
